title: format

toolchain.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf libxdo-dev nasm pkg-config gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good

build.windows:
call .\format.bat install
call .\format.bat install-desktop
call .\format.bat desktop build %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%

setup.macos: HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALLED_DEPENDENTS_CHECK=1 brew install nasm pkg-config

catalog.name: Format
catalog.summary: A chat and agent workspace for the Claude API, with a terminal, artifacts and documents.

notes_for_owner: Not in formportal's products.json: the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json; check id, name, kind, summary and state. On macOS and Linux './format desktop build' hands its arguments to ./build_app, which exits 2 on --config, so the old desktop.yml line './format desktop build --config ...' could not have run there. This entry runs setup/desktop_build (the script the launcher meant: it passes arguments to 'tauri build') after './format install' and './format install-desktop', so the macOS and Linux files are Tauri's own bundles (dmg, .app.tar.gz, AppImage, deb, rpm), not build_app's app-plus-hdiutil dmg and deb. On Windows 'format.bat desktop build %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%' passes the config to tauri build since format 0.25.1, so the Windows installer gets its updater signature too. The FFmpeg and PyAV source build (setup/build_lgpl_av) needs nasm and pkg-config: apt installs them on Linux, the macOS setup line brews them, and on Windows setup/build_lgpl_av.bat runs setup/build_lgpl_ffmpeg_msys2 in MSYS2 (pacman -Sy, MSVC's link.exe first on PATH), which needs windows_msvc. The Windows FFmpeg build has not run on a runner yet. plugins.updater.pubkey is empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made. macos-x64 runs on macos-15-intel (the old file used macos-15-intel as well).
